assets.name: 10-shadow-sorceress-battle
assets.prompt:
WORDORIA CRYSTAL QUEST STYLE — a premium 2D anime fantasy environment for a polished mobile RPG. Clean readable shapes, layered atmospheric depth, luminous violet and blue crystal glass, restrained mint magical light, moon-white resting areas, vivid but controlled color, friendly adventurous mood even in a boss setting, consistent production-game quality. Match the attached approved narrative environment's rendering, materials and palette.
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE full-bleed 16:9 landscape background plate for animated SD boss combat, ideally 1920x1080. NO characters or creatures. Low side-view arena camera, NOT a map, not an overhead view. Entire lower 34 percent is a continuous wide flat unobstructed fighting floor, edge-to-edge. Hero stands on left, boss stands on right: keep both sides equally clear, all foliage, rocks, crystals, columns and debris BEHIND the fighting floor. Subtle floor texture and restrained contrast, no deep foreground shadows hiding feet. Quiet midground behind character heads. Keep the central mobile crop functional. No text, letters, runes, UI, watermark, border, pixel art, photorealism, toy 3D, horror, gore, skulls, graves, gritty near-black darkness, excessive bloom, visual noise, characters, monsters or effects that look like an attack already happening.
World 4 stage 10 SHADOW SORCERESS boss arena, deep ILLUSION FOREST clearing. Attached image is forest setting and style authority, change its winding path into broad horizontal battle clearing. Twisting violet woodland trunks at side edges, muted plum and teal foliage, distant lavender mist and cool moon-white shafts of light. Shadow magic appears as subtle glossy dark-violet tendrils intertwined with rear roots and mirrored spectral tree silhouettes ONLY in the middle distance. No black pool covering combat floor. Small blue-violet crystals with mint rims at rear edges. One soft pale opening in the distant forest, elegant mysterious atmosphere, slightly more dramatic and cooler than ordinary forest but not frightening. The broad bottom fighting zone is pale gray-lilac earth with slight violet reflections, low contrast, no rocks or tall plants in it.
